headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic AFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the AFC North, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.
headings.footer: Updated from ESPN’s public NFL feeds. Not affiliated with the NFL, the Baltimore Ravens, or ESPN.
headings.footerTiny: Seven AFC teams qualify: four division winners and three wild cards. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from point differential and home field. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Baltimore Ravens have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
headings.injuryBlurb: Ravens listed as injured or on injured reserve. A Tuesday practice note can move before Sunday.
headings.rootingBlurb: Who needs to lose for the division or the cut line to get closer. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

narrative.blurb: The Ravens are 4-5 with a -47 point differential, one game behind the last AFC playoff spot, and two and a half games back of the Steelers in the North. 8 games left, starting Monday at home against the Chargers.

division.title: AFC North
division.detail: The Steelers lead at 6-2. The Ravens are 0-2 inside the division. Win the North and the seed is automatic.

wildcard.title: Wild card
wildcard.detail: The Patriots hold the last berth at 5-4. Three wild cards get in after the four division winners.

tiebreak.headToHead: Head-to-head inside the North: L 10–13 @ CLE; L 13–35 vs CIN.
tiebreak.detail: If the North finishes level, the NFL starts with head-to-head, then division record, then common games, then conference record. Point differential is the eye test. It is not the first tiebreaker.
